hook.text: Getting a song on a major Spotify editorial playlist can generate millions of streams overnight.

buildup.text: Playlist curators at streaming platforms hold enormous power over which artists succeed or fail.

discovery.text: Algorithmic playlists like Discover Weekly use listening data to recommend songs to individual users.

twist.text: A shady payola-like economy emerged where some curators accepted payments for playlist placement.

climax.text: Playlists have replaced radio as the primary way listeners discover new music in the streaming era.

punchline.text: A playlist spot is now more powerful than radio play.

quiz.question: What replaced radio as the primary music discovery tool?
